thread.title: All 30 Dow stocks rally premarket, led by Microsoft - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All 30 Dow stocks rally premarket, led by Microsoft - MarketWatch
text:
The 257-point rally in Dow Jones Industrial Average futures YMZ8, +1.01% is unanimous early Friday, as all 30 components are trading higher in the premarket. Among the biggest gainers, shares of Microsoft Corp. MSFT, -0.24% ran up 2.9%, Visa Inc. V, -1.32% climbed 2.6% and Cisco Systems Inc. CSCO, -3.31% rose 2.5%. The most active stock was Apple Inc.'s AAPL, -0.88% which gained 2.3%. The Dow's DJIA, -2.13% bounce follows a 1,378-point drubbing the past two sessions . Microsoft's stock had shed 5.7% the past two sessions, as part of a sharp pullback in technology stocks.
